name: contact-detail
title: Contact Detail
description: Details of a method by which an entity such as a Person or OrganisationalUnit may be contacted.
comments: The Address class should be used to store physical or postal addresses. For all other types of contact details, this class should be used.
rdfs:comment: Details of a method by which an entity such as a Person or OrganisationalUnit may be contacted.

fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:ContactDetail.
